column1: # services/gluetun/providers/custom/env.tsv — what only your own WireGuard or OpenVPN config reads (columns: lib/env.schema.tsv)

column7: your WireGuard server's public key ([Peer] PublicKey; VPN_PROVIDER=custom)
your WireGuard server's address or name ([Peer] Endpoint; a name is looked up from this host, kept current)
your WireGuard config file (.conf): its keys, address and endpoint are read into .env (VPN_PROVIDER=custom)
your OpenVPN config file (.ovpn): copied to custom/vpn/openvpn.ovpn, which gluetun runs (VPN_PROVIDER=custom, VPN_TYPE=openvpn)
